narrative.details: Your highborne lineage shines as clearly in your eyes as the sky above. You are one of us, and its youth like yourself that will help us save our home. But first, let me tell you more of our mission and plans here on Zephras... and beyond.
narrative.objectives: Listen to what Elaadrin Evengale in Valanaar has to say.
narrative.offerRewardText: So do you now see? Rediscovering the ancient magic of our forebears is the key to unlocking the secrets of Zephras Isle and securing our future, but in order to save our home, we must rediscover what we've lost these past millennia.Azeroth is the key. The Kirin Tor will show us the way.While we make ready to leave, you should check in with the other members of the High Order here in Valanaar. Most of them have tasks that they could use help from one such as yourself to see completed.
